name: EqTok
doc: **一个 token**：`inl` 是结构标签或坐标，**`inr` 是实常量**。
stmt: abbrev EqTok : Type

name: tCoord
stmt: def tCoord : ℕ

name: tConst
stmt: def tConst : ℕ

name: tAdd
stmt: def tAdd : ℕ

name: tSub
stmt: def tSub : ℕ

name: tMul
stmt: def tMul : ℕ

name: tCoord_eq
stmt: @[simp] theorem tCoord_eq : tCoord = 0

name: tConst_eq
stmt: @[simp] theorem tConst_eq : tConst = 1

name: tAdd_eq
stmt: @[simp] theorem tAdd_eq : tAdd = 2

name: tSub_eq
stmt: @[simp] theorem tSub_eq : tSub = 3

name: tMul_eq
stmt: @[simp] theorem tMul_eq : tMul = 4

name: encExpr
doc: **编码**：常量变成 `inr c`，值原样保留。
stmt:
def encExpr : GeoExpr n → List EqTok
  | .coord p axis => [.inl tCoord, .inl p, .inl axis.val]
  | .const c => [.inl tConst, .inr c]
  | .add a b => .inl tAdd :: (encExpr a ++ encExpr b)
  | .sub a b => .inl tSub :: (encExpr a ++ encExpr b)
  | .mul a b => .inl tMul :: (encExpr a ++ encExpr b)

name: encLenE
stmt:
def encLenE : GeoExpr n → ℕ
  | .coord _ _ => 3
  | .const _ => 2
  | .add a b => 1 + encLenE a + encLenE b
  | .sub a b => 1 + encLenE a + encLenE b
  | .mul a b => 1 + encLenE a + encLenE b

name: encExpr_length
stmt: theorem encExpr_length (e : GeoExpr n) : (encExpr e).length = encLenE e
proof:
by
  induction e with
  | coord p axis => rfl
  | const c => rfl
  | add a b iha ihb =>
      show (Sum.inl tAdd :: (encExpr a ++ encExpr b)).length = 1 + encLenE a + encLenE b
      simp only [List.length_cons, List.length_append, iha, ihb, encLenE]
      omega
  | sub a b iha ihb =>
      show (Sum.inl tSub :: (encExpr a ++ encExpr b)).length = 1 + encLenE a + encLenE b
      simp only [List.length_cons, List.length_append, iha, ihb, encLenE]
      omega
  | mul a b iha ihb =>
      show (Sum.inl tMul :: (encExpr a ++ encExpr b)).length = 1 + encLenE a + encLenE b
      simp only [List.length_cons, List.length_append, iha, ihb, encLenE]
      omega

name: encExpr_ge_two
doc: 每个编码至少两个 token（一个标签 + 至少一个操作数）。
stmt: theorem encExpr_ge_two (e : GeoExpr n) : 2 ≤ (encExpr e).length
proof:
by
  rw [encExpr_length]
  induction e with
  | coord p axis => show 2 ≤ 3; omega
  | const c => show 2 ≤ 2; exact Nat.le_refl 2
  | add a b iha ihb => show 2 ≤ 1 + encLenE a + encLenE b; omega
  | sub a b iha ihb => show 2 ≤ 1 + encLenE a + encLenE b; omega
  | mul a b iha ihb => show 2 ≤ 1 + encLenE a + encLenE b; omega

name: encExpr_head_inl
doc: **每个编码以 `Sum.inl` 开头**：这是 `decExpr` 的第一个模式能匹配的原因。
stmt:
theorem encExpr_head_inl (e : GeoExpr n) :
    ∃ (t : ℕ) (tl : List EqTok), encExpr e = Sum.inl t :: tl
proof:
by
  cases e with
  | coord p axis => exact ⟨_, _, rfl⟩
  | const c => exact ⟨_, _, rfl⟩
  | add a b => exact ⟨_, _, rfl⟩
  | sub a b => exact ⟨_, _, rfl⟩
  | mul a b => exact ⟨_, _, rfl⟩

name: decExpr
doc: **解码器**：带 fuel，返回表达式与消费的 token 数。
stmt:
def decExpr : ℕ → List EqTok → Option (GeoExpr n × ℕ)
  | 0, _ => none
  | _ + 1, [] => none
  | _ + 1, [_] => none
  | fuel + 1, Sum.inl t :: d :: rest =>
      if t = tCoord then
        (match d, rest with
         | Sum.inl p, Sum.inl axisVal :: _ =>
             if h : axisVal < n then some (.coord p ⟨axisVal, h⟩, 3) else none
         | _, _ => none)
      else if t = tConst then
        (match d with
         | Sum.inr c => some (.const c, 2)
         | _ => none)
      else if t = tAdd then
        (match decExpr fuel (d :: rest) with
         | some (x, c₁) =>
             match decExpr fuel ((d :: rest).drop c₁) with
             | some (y, c₂) => some (.add x y, 1 + c₁ + c₂)
             | none => none
         | none => none)
      else if t = tSub then
        (match decExpr fuel (d :: rest) with
         | some (x, c₁) =>
             match decExpr fuel ((d :: rest).drop c₁) with
             | some (y, c₂) => some (.sub x y, 1 + c₁ + c₂)
             | none => none
         | none => none)
      else if t = tMul then
        (match decExpr fuel (d :: rest) with
         | some (x, c₁) =>
             match decExpr fuel ((d :: rest).drop c₁) with
             | some (y, c₂) => some (.mul x y, 1 + c₁ + c₂)
             | none => none
         | none => none)
      else none
  | _ + 1, Sum.inr _ :: _ => none

name: decExpr_coord
doc: **坐标往返**：3 个 token，还原坐标。
stmt:
theorem decExpr_coord (p : ℕ) (axis : Fin n) (fuel : ℕ) :
    decExpr (n := n) (fuel + 1) (encExpr (n := n) (.coord p axis)) = some (.coord p axis, 3)
proof:
by
  show decExpr (n := n) (fuel + 1)
      (Sum.inl tCoord :: Sum.inl p :: Sum.inl axis.val :: []) = some (.coord p axis, 3)
  rw [decExpr]
  simp only [tCoord_eq]
  norm_num

name: decExpr_const
doc:
**常量往返**：2 个 token，**且实数值原样返回**。

这是 `ℕ` token 类型做不到的事，也是本节引入 `Sum.inr` 的理由。
stmt:
theorem decExpr_const (c : ℝ) (fuel : ℕ) :
    decExpr (n := n) (fuel + 2) (encExpr (n := n) (.const c)) = some (.const c, 2)
proof:
by
  show decExpr (n := n) (fuel + 2) (Sum.inl tConst :: Sum.inr c :: []) = some (.const c, 2)
  rw [show (fuel + 2) = (fuel + 1) + 1 from rfl]
  rw [decExpr]
  simp only [tConst_eq, tCoord_eq]
  norm_num

end EqTok

end Lattice.Geo

name: decExpr_add_step
doc: Equation lemma for the add branch, arbitrary second token.
stmt:
theorem decExpr_add_step (k : ℕ) (d : EqTok) (rest : List EqTok) :
    decExpr (n := n) (k + 1) (Sum.inl tAdd :: d :: rest) =
      (match decExpr (n := n) k (d :: rest) with
       | some (x, c₁) =>
           match decExpr (n := n) k ((d :: rest).drop c₁) with
           | some (y, c₂) => some (.add x y, 1 + c₁ + c₂)
           | none => none
       | none => none)
proof:
by
  rw [decExpr.eq_def]
  simp only [tAdd_eq, tSub_eq, tMul_eq, tCoord_eq, tConst_eq]
  norm_num
  rfl

name: encLenE_ge_two
stmt: theorem encLenE_ge_two (e : GeoExpr n) : 2 ≤ encLenE e
proof:
by
  induction e with
  | coord p axis => show 2 ≤ 3; omega
  | const c => show 2 ≤ 2; exact Nat.le_refl 2
  | add a b iha ihb => show 2 ≤ 1 + encLenE a + encLenE b; omega
  | sub a b iha ihb => show 2 ≤ 1 + encLenE a + encLenE b; omega
  | mul a b iha ihb => show 2 ≤ 1 + encLenE a + encLenE b; omega

name: drop_encExpr
doc: Dropping an encoding's length from `encExpr e ++ X` leaves `X`.
stmt:
theorem drop_encExpr (e : GeoExpr n) (X : List EqTok) :
    (encExpr e ++ X).drop (encLenE e) = X
proof:
by
  rw [← encExpr_length (n := n) e]
  simp

name: decExpr_enc
doc:
**The full round-trip, all five constructors.**

Same shape as `ConstraintTokenizer.dec_enc_append`, with one extra step: `decExpr`'s patterns need
the first token to be `Sum.inl`, so the induction must extract that with `encExpr_head_inl` before
the equation lemma can fire.
stmt:
theorem decExpr_enc (e : GeoExpr n) :
    ∀ (suffix : List EqTok) (fuel : ℕ), encLenE e ≤ fuel →
      decExpr (n := n) fuel (encExpr e ++ suffix) = some (e, encLenE e)
proof:
by
  induction e with
  | coord p axis =>
      intro suffix fuel h
      simp only [encLenE] at h
      obtain ⟨f, rfl⟩ : ∃ f, fuel = f + 3 := ⟨fuel - 3, by omega⟩
      show decExpr (n := n) (f + 3)
        ((Sum.inl tCoord :: Sum.inl p :: Sum.inl axis.val :: []) ++ suffix) =
        some (.coord p axis, 3)
      simp only [List.cons_append, List.nil_append]
      rw [show (f + 3) = ((f + 1) + 1) + 1 from rfl]
      rw [decExpr.eq_def]
      simp only [tAdd_eq, tSub_eq, tMul_eq, tCoord_eq, tConst_eq]
      norm_num
  | const c =>
      intro suffix fuel h
      simp only [encLenE] at h
      obtain ⟨f, rfl⟩ : ∃ f, fuel = f + 2 := ⟨fuel - 2, by omega⟩
      show decExpr (n := n) (f + 2)
        ((Sum.inl tConst :: Sum.inr c :: []) ++ suffix) = some (.const c, 2)
      simp only [List.cons_append, List.nil_append]
      rw [show (f + 2) = (f + 1) + 1 from rfl]
      rw [decExpr.eq_def]
      simp only [tAdd_eq, tSub_eq, tMul_eq, tCoord_eq, tConst_eq]
      norm_num
  | add a b iha ihb =>
      intro suffix fuel h
      simp only [encLenE] at h
      obtain ⟨f, rfl⟩ : ∃ f, fuel = f + 2 := ⟨fuel - 2, by
        have h1 := encLenE_ge_two a; have h2 := encLenE_ge_two b; omega⟩
      have ha : encLenE a ≤ f + 1 := by omega

      show decExpr (n := n) (f + 2)

name: decExpr_enc_nil
doc: **Every `GeoExpr` round-trips** through the real-carrying token stream.
stmt:
theorem decExpr_enc_nil (e : GeoExpr n) :
    decExpr (n := n) (encLenE e) (encExpr e) = some (e, encLenE e)
proof:
by
  have h := decExpr_enc e [] (encLenE e) (Nat.le_refl _)
  rwa [List.append_nil] at h


end EqTokRoundtrip

end Lattice.Geo
